# 4-bit AND/OR network: out = (a0&b0) | (a1&b1) | (a2&b2) | (a3&b3)
# Verified at boundary cases plus a few interior combinations.
a0=0 a1=0 a2=0 a3=0 b0=0 b1=0 b2=0 b3=0 => out=0
a0=1 a1=1 a2=1 a3=1 b0=0 b1=0 b2=0 b3=0 => out=0
a0=0 a1=0 a2=0 a3=0 b0=1 b1=1 b2=1 b3=1 => out=0
a0=1 a1=0 a2=0 a3=0 b0=1 b1=0 b2=0 b3=0 => out=1
a0=0 a1=0 a2=0 a3=1 b0=0 b1=0 b2=0 b3=1 => out=1
a0=0 a1=1 a2=0 a3=0 b0=0 b1=1 b2=0 b3=0 => out=1
a0=0 a1=0 a2=1 a3=0 b0=0 b1=0 b2=1 b3=0 => out=1
a0=1 a1=0 a2=1 a3=0 b0=0 b1=1 b2=0 b3=1 => out=0
a0=1 a1=1 a2=1 a3=1 b0=1 b1=1 b2=1 b3=1 => out=1
